subject: ClearWell renewal: request for limited term reset & outage credit
messages:
From: Anna Rivera <anna.rivera@clearwell.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@clearwell.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearWell renewal: service outage impact & renewal ask

Hi Sofia,

Thanks again for walking us through the renewal options last week. I wanted to follow up with a concrete request so we can close this before the end of the month. During February we experienced a multi-hour disruption that impacted our ingestion pipeline — our engineering and executive teams view this as material and it’s driving uncertainty around renewal.

ClearWell is at a key point: we have a proposal due by 03/31 and we need two items from Redwood to move forward with the full renewal:

- A one-time credit to offset the outage and related support costs (we are asking for $60,000).
- A term reset that aligns the contract anniversary to May 1st so our procurement cycle and budget timing line up (12-month reset).

In addition, for our critical ingestion endpoints we would like an elevated SLA (temporary uplift to 99.99% for six months) while we re-architect our backfill processes. The uplift can be scoped to specific endpoints.

We’ve attached a short incident_summary.xlsx and an invoice_dispute.pdf that laying out the billing items affected. Please let me know if Redwood can approve these concessions and the timeline for a signed amendment. Our procurement team needs the answer by 03/31 to make the renewal calendar.

Appreciate your help — this account is strategic for us and we’d like to avoid a lapse.

Best,
Anna Rivera
Head of Platform Operations
ClearWell, Inc.

Attachments: incident_summary.xlsx, invoice_dispute.pdf

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Mar 2026 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearWell renewal: service outage impact & renewal ask

Folks — forwarding ClearWell’s ask (below). Quick context: ClearWell is ~ $480k ARR, high strategic value in healthcare data partners list, and the February outage resulted in extended remediation costs for them. They’re asking for: $60k credit, 12-month term reset, and a temporary SLA uplift to 99.99% for six months. Procurement wants a yes/no by 03/31.

My recommendation (to balance retention and economics):
- Term reset: approve for 6 months (not 12) to move their renewal window without locking us in long-term exposure.
- One-time credit: up to $40,000 subject to Finance approval and reconciliation of the billed items in invoice_dispute.pdf.
- SLA uplift: provide a scoped 6-month SLA addendum (99.95% for critical endpoints) with clear off-ramp language and success metrics; require CS-led biweekly QBRs for the duration.

If leadership can greenlight the above (deal desk + Finance + Legal to finalize language), I’ll get Legal the contract_redline.pdf and route the amendment for DocuSign. We need an exec OK to hit the customer deadline.

Requesting: 1) Ben or Laura: please confirm sign-off authority / cap. 2) Evelyn: if CS can commit to the QBR cadence and execution plan.

—Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachment: contract_redline.pdf
